data.narrative:
ParityQC is a Series A quantum computing company founded by Wolfgang Lechner and Magdalena Hauser. The broader quantum computing sector comprises 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms, including well-capitalized peers such as Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Standard peer-median valuation proved inapplicable to ParityQC. Of the 6 same-sector peers examined, none satisfied concurrent criteria for stage alignment, valuation-tier proximity, or adjacent-stage positioning. The quantum computing market remains sufficiently heterogeneous and early-stage that filtering for 3 or more comparables at an equivalent development stage yielded zero matches. Reliance on all-sector median multiples would obscure material differences in technology maturity, capitalization history, and go-to-market readiness across the peer set.

This analysis therefore cannot support a triangulated valuation range without additional proprietary data on recent transaction prices, lead investor participation, or internal financial metrics (revenue, cash burn, customer pipeline). The wider peer universe—encompassing mature private rounds and public valuations spanning Quantinuum through smaller-cap public entrants—remains too dispersed to anchor a credible Series A estimate. A defensible valuation would require either (1) disclosed transaction data from temporally proximate Series A closes in quantum hardware or software, or (2) management-provided metrics enabling revenue or customer-based methods. Neither is available here.
